# ThirdParty art

Vendored **CC0** low-poly packs. See `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` for links and licenses.

Unity imports OBJ/FBX on first project open. Gameplay loads nature/loot OBJs via `Freehold.Art.Pack.ObjMeshLoader` at runtime; the hero FBX loads from `Resources/Characters/Hero` (or Editor AssetDatabase path).
